# SEO-035: Declare the document primary language on the root html element

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Domain | `metadata` |

| Evidence tier | `A` |
| Confidence | `HIGH` |

## Statement

The html element of every response carries a lang attribute holding a well-formed BCP 47 tag that names the language the page's main content is actually written in.

## Rationale

Assistive technology selects a pronunciation profile from this attribute and localization tooling uses it to decide which pages belong to which language, so an absent or wrong value degrades both without producing any visible error.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Set the attribute in the root document template. On a multilingual site, derive it from the same source of truth that selects the content locale rather than hardcoding one tag, and mark inline passages in another language with their own lang attribute.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Read the lang attribute from the root element of each served response and compare the declared tag against the language of the page's main content.
- Evidence: `RENDERED_HTML`, `ROUTE`
- Automated check: `html-lang-present`
